title: रवि-ऋषि संवाद : प्रधानमन्त्री उत्पादन गर्दै जाउँला नि !
content:
काठमाठौं । छठ पर्वको अवसरमा तराई झरेका राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टी (रास्वपा)का सभापति रवि लामिछाने र पूर्वपत्रकार ऋषि धमला जनकपुरधाममा भेटिए । उनीहरूबीच केहीबेर राेचक संवाद भयाे । छठ पूजापछि सोमबार बिहान भएको भेटमा उनीहरू विगतको राजनीतिक प्रसङ्गदेखि देशको नेतृत्व र विकासका विषयमा गफिएका थिए । लामिछानेले धमलालाई विगतको निर्वाचनमा आफूले गरेको प्रस्ताव अस्वीकार गरेको प्रसंग काेट्याए । ‘सहकार्य गरेर जाऔँ´ भन्दा मेरो सल्लाह मान्नुभएन नि,’ लामिछानेले धमलालाई भने । जवाफमा धमलाले भने, ‘तपाईंले टिकट त दिनुभएकाे हाे । अब सल्लाह गराैला नि । देश बनाउने कुरामा सय प्रतिशत साथ दिन्छु ।’ गत फागुन २१ गते सम्पन्न प्रतिनिधिसभा निर्वाचनका क्रममा रास्वपाका तर्फबाट उम्मेदवार बन्न लामिछाने र बालेन शाहले धमलालाई प्रस्ताव गरेका थिए । तर धमलाले उक्त प्रस्ताव स्वीकार गरेका थिएनन् । छुट्टिने बेला धमलाले लामिछानेलाई देशको नेतृत्व गर्नुपर्ने सुझाव दिए । उनले बालेन शाहपछि प्रधानमन्त्री बन्नुपर्ने बताएपछि लामिछानेले त्यसको जवाफ रोचक शैलीमा दिएका थिए । ‘बालेन शाहपछि प्रधानमन्त्री बन्नुपर्छ,’ धमलाको सुझाव थियो । जवाफमा लामिछानेले भने, ‘पर्दैन पर्दैन, किन चाहियो प्रधानमन्त्री ? हामीलाई केही पर्दै पर्दैन । प्रधानमन्त्री उत्पादन गर्दै जाउँला नि ।’ Kathmandu. An interesting conversation took place between Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSWP) President Rabi Lamichhane and senior journalist and President of Independent Citizens' Movement Nepal, Rishi Dhamala, who reached Janakpurdham on the occasion of Chhath festival. In a surprise meeting on Monday morning after Chhath Puja, the two discussed the past political context, the country's leadership and development. During the meeting, Lamichhane reminded Dhamala of the past election and raised the issue of his rejection of the proposal he had made. "You didn't listen to my advice to cooperate," Lamichhane told Dhamala. In response, Dhamala reminded him that he had been offered the ticket, saying, "You gave him the ticket." During the House of Representatives elections held on February 21, Lamichhane and Balen Shah had proposed to Dhamala to be a candidate from the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). However, Dhamala did not accept the proposal. During the meeting, when they were parting ways, Dhamala suggested that Lamichhane should lead the country. When he suggested that Balen Shah should become the Prime Minister, Lamichhane responded in a very interesting manner. "Balen Shah should become the Prime Minister," Dhamala suggested. In response, Lamichhane said, "It doesn't matter, why do we need a Prime Minister? We don't care, we will continue to produce Prime Ministers!" Lamichhane's smiling response, looking at Dhamala, made the meeting even more interesting. After the meeting, the two even posed for a photo together. During the photoshoot, participants commented that they looked like the Prime Minister and the leader of the main opposition party. During the meeting, both were positive about working together for the development and prosperity of the country. Dhamala had expressed his commitment to provide 100 percent support in the campaign for nation-building and prosperity. Lamichhane had said to Dhamala, "You didn't listen to my advice when I said let's cooperate," to which Dhamala had replied, "Now let's consult, we are all experiencing it. We have 100 percent support in building the country." When taking a photo together after the meeting, the participants said that they looked like a prime minister and a leader of the main opposition party.
